WITH periods AS (SELECT DISTINCT period_start FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND fact_type = 'sales' AND NOT period_start IS NULL ORDER BY period_start DESC LIMIT 2), agg AS (SELECT rf.period_start, SUM(CASE WHEN rf.metric_key = 'sales_target' THEN rf.numeric_value END) AS sales_target, SUM(CASE WHEN rf.metric_key = 'revenue' THEN rf.numeric_value END) AS revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN rf.metric_key = 'units_sold' THEN rf.numeric_value END) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN periods AS p ON p.period_start = rf.period_start WHERE rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.fact_type = 'sales' GROUP BY rf.period_start) SELECT a.period_start, a.sales_target, a.revenue, a.units_sold, a.fact_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report_facts AS t WHERE t.status = 'confirmed' AND t.metric_key = 'sales_target') AS sales_target_fact_count FROM agg AS a ORDER BY a.period_start DESC
